validity_findings.description: decompress_body is called on b''.join(chunks) after full byte accumulation, not as incremental decompression during chunk arrival via streaming decompressor APIs (brotli.Decompressor.process, gzip.GzipFile streaming). The chunk boundary test is at the HTTP Transfer-Encoding framing layer (proxy forwards partial frames, client reassembles), NOT at the decompressor streaming API layer. This is correctly disclosed in result.json:validity_notes V1 and report.md.

validity_findings.description: requests with stream=True may internally buffer; mitigated by using resp.raw.read(stream_chunk_size) directly instead of iter_content. X-Proxy-Mode header verification and byte-identical body hashes between streaming/buffered paths confirm no hidden reassembly corruption at HTTP layer for this localhost setup.
validity_findings.impact: Measurement valid for localhost; real CDN may have different TCP segmentation behavior.

validity_findings.description: Streaming proxy STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE and streaming client read size set equal per cell (8192 or 32). No mixed-size matrix (e.g., proxy 8192/client 32) tested. Equal-size alignment maximizes boundary intersection density but does not test all proxy/client chunk size combinations.

validity_findings.description: Mock origin always chunks at 32 bytes before reaching proxy; proxy's streaming read re-chunks at 8192/32. This additive layering is faithful to CDN behavior where origin chunks are re-framed by edge, but only one origin chunk size tested.
validity_findings.impact: Single origin chunk size tested; CDN origin chunk sizes vary in practice.

validity_findings.description: Correctness oracle is in-process generate_*_body(state, target_size) SHA256. Correctness means matches deterministic generator, not independent corpus. Inherited from parent chain (EXP-RUNTIME-35495699298) and bounded to same interpreter session determinism.
evidence_refs: run_experiment.py:549-551 (expected_hash computed from generator in same process)
validity_findings.impact: Oracle is self-consistency check, not independent ground truth. Cross-run reproducibility not claimed.

validity_findings.description: BINARY body header contains struct.pack(hash(state)) which is PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent. Determinism holds within single process (confirmed all_same=true across reps); cross-run reproducibility not claimed and not tested per parent do_not_assume.
validity_findings.impact: BINARY ground truth not portable across interpreter sessions; within-experiment determinism confirmed.

validity_findings.description: All requests to 127.0.0.1; no real CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai), no geographic latency, no TCP segmentation beyond localhost loopback, no concurrent clients, no Accept-Encoding negotiation beyond br,gzip,identity. Localhost streaming correctness does not imply CDN correctness but removes V1_BUFFERED_PROXY_NOT_STREAMING blocker.
validity_findings.impact: CDN testing remains next gate; this experiment unblocks framing-layer correctness only.

claim_ceiling: Iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity, max_depth=5, gzip level 1/None, brotli quality 4/6) on localhost mock with Transfer-Encoding chunked incremental forwarding (StreamingProxyHandler reads upstream_resp.read(STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE) in loop without full-body buffering; client accumulates via resp.raw.read(stream_chunk_size) then calls decompress_body) produces byte-identical SHA256 output to buffered ground truth and in-process oracle for high-entropy payloads (JSON 5.49, HTML 4.66, BINARY 7.69 bits/byte) at 10KB/100KB nominal (compressed 2.7-99KB) across JSON/HTML/BINARY, GZIP-THEN-BROTLI and BROTLI-THEN-GZIP, 4 auth states, chunk sizes 8192 (realistic CDN) and 32 (stress), Python 3.12 brotli 1.2.0. NOT validated: true incremental decompression via streaming decompressor APIs (brotli.Decompressor.process, gzip streaming without accumulation), depths 3-5 stacked encodings, other compression levels/qualities, payloads >100KB, real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai) with Accept-Encoding negotiation, Vary/cache, geographic latency, concurrency. Cross-run BINARY reproducibility across PYTHONHASHSEED not claimed. This resolves V1_BUFFERED_PROXY_NOT_STREAMING at the framing layer only; CDN gate remains.

The present test proves Transfer-Encoding chunking does not corrupt the byte stream; decompressor streaming state machine across arbitrary Brotli block boundaries remains untested at the API level.

Does decompression correctness hold on real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai free tier) with high-entropy payloads, Accept-Encoding negotiation, Vary/cache, geographic latency, and concurrency at 8KB chunk sizes?
Does correctness hold for payloads beyond 100KB nominal (e.g., 500KB, 1MB) where brotli/gzip dictionary windows cross chunk boundaries more frequently?
Do other gzip levels (2-9) and brotli qualities (5-7, 8-11) produce compressed structures that stress chunk boundaries differently at realistic sizes?
Cross-run BINARY ground truth reproducibility across interpreter sessions with different PYTHONHASHSEED and gzip/brotli library versions (1.2.0 vs future) remains untested.
Mixed proxy/client chunk size combinations (e.g., proxy 8192 / client 32) not tested; equal-size alignment used.
Single origin chunk size (32B) tested; CDN origin chunk sizes vary in practice.
